source:
treemap-beta
"Category A"
    "Item A1": 10
    "Item A2": 20
"Category B"
    "Item B1": 15
    "Item B2": 25

treemap-beta
"Products"
    "Electronics"
        "Phones": 50
        "Computers": 30
        "Accessories": 20
    "Clothing"
        "Men's": 40
        "Women's": 40

treemap-beta
"Section 1"
    "Leaf 1.1": 12
    "Section 1.2":::class1
      "Leaf 1.2.1": 12
"Section 2"
    "Leaf 2.1": 20:::class1
    "Leaf 2.2": 25
    "Leaf 2.3": 12

classDef class1 fill:red,color:blue,stroke:#FFD600;

treemap-beta
"Main"
    "A": 20
    "B":::important
        "B1": 10
        "B2": 15
    "C": 5

classDef important fill:#f96,stroke:#333,stroke-width:2px;

---
config:
    theme: 'forest'
---
treemap-beta
"Category A"
    "Item A1": 10
    "Item A2": 20
"Category B"
    "Item B1": 15
    "Item B2": 25

---
config:
  treemap:
    diagramPadding: 200
---
treemap-beta
"Category A"
    "Item A1": 10
    "Item A2": 20
"Category B"
    "Item B1": 15
    "Item B2": 25

---
config:
  treemap:
    valueFormat: '$0,0'
---
treemap-beta
"Budget"
    "Operations"
        "Salaries": 700000
        "Equipment": 200000
        "Supplies": 100000
    "Marketing"
        "Advertising": 400000
        "Events": 100000

---
config:
  treemap:
    valueFormat: '$.1%'
---
treemap-beta
"Market Share"
    "Company A": 0.35
    "Company B": 0.25
    "Company C": 0.15
    "Others": 0.25

---
description: >-
  treemap-beta "Root" with three flat leaves; two of the three (Item A,
  Item C) are tagged with distinct classDefs (redClass, blueClass) that set
  only a fill color, verifying classDef fill-color styling applies
  correctly to individual leaf nodes.
---
treemap-beta
  "Root"
    "Item A": 30:::redClass
    "Item B": 20
    "Item C": 25:::blueClass

  classDef redClass fill:#ff0000;
  classDef blueClass fill:#0000ff;

---
description: >-
  treemap-beta "Products" with two sections (Electronics, Furniture), each
  styled with a classDef that sets a background fill plus a text color
  (white text on a dark fill vs black text on a light fill), verifying
  classDef color styling applies to node text labels.
---
treemap-beta
  "Products"
    "Electronics":::whiteText
      "Phones": 40
      "Laptops": 30
    "Furniture":::darkText
      "Chairs": 25
      "Tables": 20

  classDef whiteText fill:#2c3e50,color:#ffffff;
  classDef darkText fill:#ecf0f1,color:#000000;

---
description: >-
  treemap-beta "Budget" with two sections (Critical, Normal), each styled
  via a classDef that combines fill, text color, stroke color, and
  stroke-width simultaneously, verifying multiple classDef properties can
  be applied together to a single node.
---
treemap-beta
  "Budget"
    "Critical":::critical
      "Server Costs": 50000
      "Salaries": 80000
    "Normal":::normal
      "Office Supplies": 5000
      "Marketing": 15000

  classDef critical fill:#e74c3c,color:#fff,stroke:#c0392b,stroke-width:3px;
  classDef normal fill:#3498db,color:#fff,stroke:#2980b9,stroke-width:1px;

---
description: >-
  treemap-beta "Company" with a nested Engineering section (styled via its
  own classDef) whose leaves are further tagged individually with a second
  "highlight" classDef, plus a sibling Sales section with one highlighted
  leaf. Verifies classDef styling can be layered at both the nested-section
  level and the individual-leaf level within the same diagram.
---
treemap-beta
  "Company"
    "Engineering":::engSection
      "Frontend": 30:::highlight
      "Backend": 40
      "DevOps": 20:::highlight
    "Sales"
      "Direct": 35
      "Channel": 25:::highlight

  classDef engSection fill:#9b59b6,stroke:#8e44ad,stroke-width:2px;
  classDef highlight fill:#f39c12,color:#000,stroke:#e67e22,stroke-width:2px;

---
description: >-
  Same minimal two-section, four-leaf treemap-beta structure as the basic
  smoke test, rendered under the dark theme to check that node and label
  text stays readable against dark-theme colors.
---
treemap-beta
  "Category A"
    "Item A1": 10
    "Item A2": 20
  "Category B"
    "Item B1": 15
    "Item B2": 25

---
description: >-
  Same minimal two-section, four-leaf treemap-beta structure as the basic
  smoke test, rendered under the neutral theme to check that node and label
  text stays readable against neutral-theme colors.
---
treemap-beta
  "Category A"
    "Item A1": 10
    "Item A2": 20
  "Category B"
    "Item B1": 15
    "Item B2": 25

---
description: >-
  treemap-beta "Products" with three levels of hierarchy: a flat
  Electronics section with three leaves, and a Clothing section containing
  two sub-sections (Men's, Women's) that each hold two leaves. Basic test
  of multi-level hierarchical nesting without any styling.
---
treemap-beta
  "Products"
    "Electronics"
      "Phones": 50
      "Computers": 30
      "Accessories": 20
    "Clothing"
      "Men's"
        "Shirts": 10
        "Pants": 15
      "Women's"
        "Dresses": 20
        "Skirts": 10

---
description: >-
  treemap-beta with a single section containing one leaf whose label is a
  very long sentence-length string, alongside one short leaf, verifying
  that long node labels wrap to multiple lines instead of overflowing.
---
treemap-beta
  "Main Category"
    "This is a very long item name that should wrap to the next line when rendered in the treemap diagram": 50
    "Short item": 20

children.label: This is a very long item name that should wrap to the next line when rendered in the treemap diagram

source:
---
description: >-
  treemap-beta with four levels of nesting (Level 1 > Level 2A/2B >
  Level 3A-D > Level 4A/4B under Level 3D), testing that the renderer
  correctly lays out sections nested more than two or three levels deep.
---
treemap-beta
  "Level 1"
    "Level 2A"
      "Level 3A": 10
      "Level 3B": 15
    "Level 2B"
      "Level 3C": 20
      "Level 3D"
        "Level 4A": 5
        "Level 4B": 5

---
description: >-
  Frontmatter sets treemap.valueFormat to '$0,0' (dollar sign with
  thousands separator, no decimals). Uses the `treemap` diagram keyword
  (not treemap-beta) with a "Budget" hierarchy of Operations/Marketing
  sections and multiple six-figure leaf values, verifying currency
  formatting with thousands separators renders correctly.
config:
  treemap:
    valueFormat: '$0,0'
---
treemap
  "Budget"
    "Operations"
      "Salaries": 700000
      "Equipment": 200000
      "Supplies": 100000
    "Marketing"
      "Advertising": 400000
      "Events": 100000

---
description: >-
  Frontmatter sets treemap.valueFormat to '.1%' (percentage with one
  decimal place). "Market Share" section with four leaves holding
  fractional values (0.15-0.35), verifying percentage-format rendering of
  leaf values.
config:
  treemap:
    valueFormat: '.1%'
---
treemap-beta
  "Market Share"
    "Company A": 0.35
    "Company B": 0.25
    "Company C": 0.15
    "Others": 0.25

---
description: >-
  Frontmatter sets treemap.valueFormat to '.2f' (plain two-decimal float,
  with no percent or currency symbol). "Metrics" section with four small
  fractional leaf values, verifying plain decimal formatting.
config:
  treemap:
    valueFormat: '.2f'
---
treemap-beta
  "Metrics"
    "Conversion Rate": 0.0567
    "Bounce Rate": 0.6723
    "Click-through Rate": 0.1289
    "Engagement": 0.4521

---
description: >-
  Frontmatter sets treemap.valueFormat to '$.2f' (dollar sign with two
  decimals, no thousands separator). "Product Prices" section with four
  sub-200 leaf values, verifying currency formatting without a thousands
  separator.
config:
  treemap:
    valueFormat: '$.2f'
---
treemap-beta
  "Product Prices"
    "Basic": 19.99
    "Standard": 49.99
    "Premium": 99.99
    "Enterprise": 199.99

---
description: >-
  treemap-beta "User Counts" with four large integer leaf values (tens of
  thousands to over a million) and no explicit valueFormat config,
  verifying the default number formatting applies a thousands separator to
  large plain integers.
---
treemap-beta
  "User Counts"
    "Active Users": 1250345
    "New Signups": 45789
    "Churned": 12350
    "Converted": 78975

---
description: >-
  Frontmatter config block sets treemap.valueFormat to '$0,0' (dollar sign
  with thousands separator, no decimals). "Sales by Region" section with
  four seven-figure leaf values, verifying currency plus thousands-
  separator formatting configured through frontmatter config.
config:
  treemap:
    valueFormat: '$0,0'
---
treemap-beta
  "Sales by Region"
    "North": 1234567
    "South": 7654321
    "East": 4567890
    "West": 9876543

---
description: >-
  treemap-beta "Scientific Values" with three leaves spanning very
  different magnitudes (about 1.2 million, a tiny fraction near 0.00001,
  and one billion) with no explicit valueFormat, verifying default
  formatting handles extreme value ranges, including scientific-notation-
  scale numbers, without configuration.
---
treemap-beta
  "Scientific Values"
    "Value 1": 1234567
    "Value 2": 0.0000123
    "Value 3": 1000000000

---
description: >-
  Minimal smoke test for treemap-beta: two top-level sections (Category A,
  Category B), each containing two leaf nodes with numeric values, with no
  styling or formatting applied.
---
treemap-beta
  "Category A"
    "Item A1": 10
    "Item A2": 20
  "Category B"
    "Item B1": 15
    "Item B2": 25

---
description: >-
  treemap-beta mirroring the example used in the treemap documentation: two
  sections where Section 1 nests a sub-section (Section 1.2) with its own
  leaf, while Section 2 is flat with three leaves; a classDef (class1) is
  applied to both a nested section and a leaf to show styling can target
  either level.
---
treemap-beta
  "Section 1"
    "Leaf 1.1": 12
    "Section 1.2":::class1
      "Leaf 1.2.1": 12
  "Section 2"
    "Leaf 2.1": 20:::class1
    "Leaf 2.2": 25
    "Leaf 2.3": 12

  classDef class1 fill:red,color:blue,stroke:#FFD600;

---
description: >-
  Same two-section, four-leaf treemap-beta structure as the basic smoke
  test, with %% comment lines interspersed before each section, verifying
  that comments are correctly ignored by the parser.
---
treemap-beta
  %% This is a comment
  "Category A"
    "Item A1": 10
    "Item A2": 20
  %% Another comment
  "Category B"
    "Item B1": 15
    "Item B2": 25

---
description: >-
  treemap-beta with two sections, each tagged with a distinct classDef:
  Category A gets a thick solid red border (stroke-width 8px), Category B
  gets a dashed black border (stroke-dasharray) of the same width, verifying
  classDef stroke styling (solid vs dashed, color) applies to section
  containers.
---
treemap-beta
  %% This is a comment
  "Category A":::thickBorder
    "Item A1": 10
    "Item A2": 20
  %% Another comment
  "Category B":::dashedBorder
    "Item B1": 15
    "Item B2": 25

  classDef thickBorder stroke:red,stroke-width:8px;
  classDef dashedBorder stroke:black,stroke-dasharray:5,stroke-width:8px;

---
description: >-
  Large, real-world-style treemap-beta with three top-level, emoji-labeled
  sections (High/Medium/Low activity) containing dozens of nested leaf
  nodes representing package and file paths, each with numeric values and
  leaf-level classDef color classes. Exercises label rendering and layout
  for a complex, many-leaf treemap.
---
treemap-beta
  "🔴 High Activity (Top 50%)":::redContainer
    "packages/app (1115)": 15:::redleaf
    "packages/app/src (844)": 12:::redleaf
    "packages/app/src/lib (707)": 11:::redleaf
    "packages/app/src/routes (353)": 7:::redleaf
    "packages/app/tests (277)": 6:::redleaf
    "packages/app/tests/e2e (245)": 6:::redleaf
    "packages/app/tests/common (48)": 4:::redleaf
    "packages/llm-prompts (29)": 3:::redleaf
    "packages/emails (26)": 3:::redleaf
    "packages/app/tests/api (23)": 3:::redleaf
    "packages/emails/src (18)": 3:::redleaf
    "packages/emails/src/emails (17)": 3:::redleaf
    "packages/app/static (15)": 3:::redleaf
    "packages/llm-prompts/diagram-chat (15)": 3:::redleaf
    "packages/app/prisma (11)": 3:::redleaf
    "packages/app/prisma/migrations (11)": 3:::redleaf
    "packages/llm-prompts/shared (9)": 3:::redleaf
    "packages/app/static/icons (8)": 3:::redleaf
    "packages/emails/src/components (8)": 3:::redleaf
    "packages/app-observability (8)": 3:::redleaf
    "packages/mermaid-pre-render-server (8)": 3:::redleaf
  "🟠 Medium Activity (35%)":::orangeContainer
    "packages/app/tests/mobile (6)": 3:::orangeleaf
    "packages/llm-prompts/diagram-chat/tests (6)": 3:::orangeleaf
    "packages/eslint-plugin (6)": 3:::orangeleaf
    "packages/eslint-plugin/src (5)": 3:::orangeleaf
    "packages/eslint-plugin/src/rules (5)": 3:::orangeleaf
    "packages/app/static/img (4)": 3:::orangeleaf
    "packages/llm-prompts/tests (4)": 3:::orangeleaf
    "packages/llm-prompts/common (3)": 3:::orangeleaf
    "packages/mermaid-pre-render-server/tests (3)": 3:::orangeleaf
    "packages/mermaid-pre-render-server/tests/e2e (3)": 3:::orangeleaf
    "packages/app/tests/seed (2)": 3:::orangeleaf
    "packages/llm-prompts/shared/patches (2)": 3:::orangeleaf
    "packages/mermaid-pre-render-server/src (2)": 3:::orangeleaf
    "packages/app/scripts (1)": 3:::orangeleaf
  "🟡 Low Activity (15%)":::yellowContainer
    "packages/llm-prompts/regenerate-diagram (1)": 3:::yellowleaf
    "packages/llm-prompts/repair-diagram (1)": 3:::yellowleaf
    "packages/app-buildship (1)": 3:::yellowleaf
    "packages/app-buildship/src (1)": 3:::yellowleaf
    "packages/app-buildship/src/cleanupAssets (1)": 3:::yellowleaf
    "packages/icons (1)": 3:::yellowleaf

  classDef root fill:#F5BA71
  classDef redContainer fill:#F54927
  classDef orangeContainer fill:#DE8118
  classDef yellowContainer fill:#F5E514

  classDef redleaf fill:#F54927,stroke:none,color:#FFFFFF
  classDef orangeleaf fill:#DE8118,stroke:none,color:#FFFFFF
  classDef yellowleaf fill:#F5E514,stroke:none,color:#333333

---
description: >-
  treemap-beta with two sections; Section 1 nests a sub-section
  (Section 1.2) with its own leaf, while Section 2 is flat with three
  leaves. A classDef (class1) is applied to both a nested section and a
  leaf node to exercise classDef-based styling across hierarchy levels.
---
treemap-beta
  "Section 1"
    "Leaf 1.1": 12
    "Section 1.2":::class1
      "Leaf 1.2.1": 12
  "Section 2"
    "Leaf 2.1": 20:::class1
    "Leaf 2.2": 25
    "Leaf 2.3": 12

  classDef class1 fill:red,color:blue,stroke:#FFD600;

---
description: >-
  Same minimal two-section, four-leaf treemap-beta structure as the basic
  smoke test, rendered under the forest theme to verify the treemap looks
  correct with that theme applied.
---
treemap-beta
  "Category A"
    "Item A1": 10
    "Item A2": 20
  "Category B"
    "Item B1": 15
    "Item B2": 25

---
description: >-
  treemap-beta with a "Main" section containing a plain leaf (A), a nested
  sub-section (B) whose two leaves inherit a classDef (important), and a
  leaf (C) styled via a second classDef (secondary) that uses
  stroke-dasharray. Exercises applying multiple distinct classDef styles
  within a single diagram.
---
treemap-beta
  "Main"
    "A": 20
    "B":::important
      "B1": 10
      "B2": 15
    "C": 5:::secondary

  classDef important fill:#f96,stroke:#333,stroke-width:2px;
  classDef secondary fill:#6cf,stroke:#333,stroke-dasharray:5 5;

---
description: >-
  Frontmatter sets treemap.valueFormat to '$,.2f' (dollar sign, thousands
  separator, two decimal places). Single "Revenue" section with four
  quarterly leaf values to verify combined currency, thousands-separator,
  and decimal-place formatting.
config:
  treemap:
    valueFormat: '$,.2f'
---
treemap-beta
  "Revenue"
    "Q1": 1250345.75
    "Q2": 1645789.25
    "Q3": 1845123.50
    "Q4": 2145678.75

---
description: >-
  treemap-beta "Company Budget" with three sections (Engineering,
  Marketing, Sales), each styled with its own classDef and each containing
  multiple numeric leaf values. Exercises a combination of multi-level
  sections, per-section classDef styling, and leaf values in one realistic
  diagram.
---
treemap-beta
  "Company Budget"
    "Engineering":::engineering
      "Frontend": 300000
      "Backend": 400000
      "DevOps": 200000
    "Marketing":::marketing
      "Digital": 250000
      "Print": 100000
      "Events": 150000
    "Sales":::sales
      "Direct": 500000
      "Channel": 300000

  classDef engineering fill:#6b9bc3,stroke:#333;
  classDef marketing fill:#c36b9b,stroke:#333;
  classDef sales fill:#c3a66b,stroke:#333;
